free_tier.stated: No byte quota - free CDN/edge services for eligible OSS projects and the nonprofits that support them. Scope set per applicant after review.

egress.terms: This is the egress: Fastly absorbs bandwidth for accepted projects. Origin still has to exist and be paid for elsewhere.

tooling: Fastly CDN/VCL, custom VCL or Compute@Edge; standard HTTP origin pull.
chaining: Use as the free front door over any of the qualifying origins (Hugging Face, Internet Archive, a university bucket). Turns a metered origin into an unmetered public read path.
limits_note: Google Form application; acceptance discretionary and reviewed by a human. Must be open-licensed, community-centred, 'built on trust'. No published SLA. Not a storage product at all.
reliability_note: Established programme (relaunched 2022) with real OSS members (PyPI historically). Risk is acceptance, not durability. Adds a third-party dependency in the read path.

evidence.proved: 'we extend free services to eligible open source projects and nonprofits that support them'; application is an embedded Google Form
'Fast Forward will offer free services to open source projects and the nonprofits that support them'
